title: agropyron occidentale var. palmeri
intro: Agropyron occidentale var. palmeri, commonly known as Big Bluestem, is a perennial grass species native to North America. It is used in traditional herbal medicine to promote digestive health and alleviate symptoms of gastrointestinal issues, such as bloating and indigestion, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Big Bluestem include its anti-inflammatory, carminative, and anti-spasmodic properties, which help to soothe digestive discomfort and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Big Bluestem include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
